notes.title: Bug fixes and small updates
notes.notes:
Some bugs were fixed/some stuff was optimized

Minimap has fog of war and will always be active without a cost.

notes.title: Minimap update and saved maps
notes.notes:
Minimap has been updated to be better, still some errors in some areas, but it runs a bit better everywhere else now.
 The game now comes with MapImages.zip which has every map in the game. If you need to look at a map with the minimap not being helpful to you, please go to the game directory and open MapImages.zip and look at the map that way.

Due to many reasons the Minimap cannot be updated any further without bringing errors in other parts of the game. This is why MapImages.zip has been added to the game files for the two areas in the game (No Man's Land and Gaea Forest) where it will be the most helpful.

notes.title: Bug fixes and re-implimenting localization support
notes.notes:
The main thing done is re-implimenting the translation. If you are playing in English, you won't see the impact. If you are not, then expect a major download for it.

The original implementation had a bunch of bugs pop up from multiple users and tests along with not applying the translation in certain places. I'm sorry I was not able to discover this sooner.

The new re-implementation should fix the bugs and showcase the translations in most areas where it should.

notes.title: New Demo update: New classes and difficulty options!
notes.notes:
Changes to the demo include:

New Classes:

 The Slime: A mistake not meant to live. An experiment to remove all bones so you can no longer be injured and stronger in battle, it comes with a downside. Your body is made out of a liquid mush that is weak to everything. Only those who wish for pain choose the slime.
 The Blameless: One who is random with their speech, and their spells. They cannot be blamed for their actions, as every time they open their mouths, it is unknown what will come out. Beasts of the Umbra Fields attack them last, knowing their randomness can be beneficial. 


New difficulty options! Chosen right when a new game starts, cannot be changed later.

 Normal: The way the game was meant to be played.
 Hard: When someone in the party is stunned, most enemies will take the opportunity to steal some gold. You will not have money very long, so spend it when you do.
 Very Hard: Enemies have a higher change to injure on attacks with small resistances to all aliments.
 Impossible: Every enemy will have access to Level Drain, a skill that removes a level from the party if fights are long enough. Longer fights are discouraged unless necessary. Enemies also get buffs to their damage. Made to break players who choose this mode.


Some bugs were fixed as well.
